按平台统计营业额（不含关闭/未付款/已删除，已扣退款）

SELECT platform,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price - COALESCE(refunded_amount, 0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status_group IN ('completed', 'unknown')
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY revenue DESC
营业额最高的 10 个 SKU

SELECT sku,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price - COALESCE(refunded_amount, 0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status_group IN ('completed', 'unknown')
GROUP BY sku
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT province,
       COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE status_group IN ('completed', 'unknown')
  AND province IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY province
ORDER BY orders DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(price - COALESCE(refunded_amount, 0))::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders
WHERE status_group IN ('completed', 'unknown')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

SELECT platform,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       ROUND(AVG(price - COALESCE(refunded_amount, 0))::numeric, 2) AS average_spend
FROM orders
WHERE status_group IN ('completed', 'unknown') AND price IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY orders DESC
本月被排除的订单（关闭/未付款/已删除）

SELECT platform, status_group, raw_status, COUNT(*) AS orders
FROM orders
WHERE status_group NOT IN ('completed', 'unknown')
  AND order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY platform, status_group, raw_status
ORDER BY orders DESC

SELECT filename, platform, inserted_orders,
       duplicate_rows, invalid_rows, uploaded_at
FROM upload_batches
ORDER BY uploaded_at DESC
LIMIT 20
